title: WYBOT C1 Pro Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner with App

comparisons.notes: WYBOT C1 Pro, Gray, model WY-AMUS-051, UPC 6975843743763; $454.54 with Buy Now on Best Buy's pool-cleaning-robots category page for SKU CZTFJYVQ76. Photo matches Woot's unit.

writeup: Woot has the WYBOT C1 Pro cordless robotic pool cleaner for $199.99, about 56% below Best Buy's marketplace price of $454.54 for the same C1 Pro (model WY-AMUS-051). It's a tracked, app-connected robot rated for 65W suction and up to 150 minutes per charge, and it cleans the floor, walls and waterline of in-ground pools. Woot shows a limit of 3 per order with limited stock.
